Term1: Tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis, tinea manuum, or tinea cruris
Text:
# TINEA PEDIS (ATHLETE'S FOOT), TINEA CORPORIS, TINEA MANUUM, OR TINEA CRURIS

Dermatophyte fungal infections are common worldwide. Dermatophytes metabolize and subsist upon keratin in the skin, hair, and nails. Most tinea infections can often be cured with topical therapy alone. Systemic therapy is reserved for severe or refractory infection, recurrent infection, or in immunocompromised patients.

Treatment should continue for at least one week after clinical curing of infection.

Therapy:
## Treatment
Terbinafine 1% cream apply to affected area BID x 2-4 weeks [M]

## Alternative
Clotrimazole 1% cream apply to affected area BID x 4 weeks [M]

## Systemic treatment
Fluconazole 150 mg q week x 2-4 weeks [R,DI]
< OR >
Terbinafine 250 mg PO QDAY x 2 weeks [R,H,DI,O]
